QVariant ToolSearchPlugin::search(QStrin.name: tool_search
QVariant ToolSearchPlugin::search(QStrin.title: Search tools
QVariant ToolSearchPlugin::search(QStrin.description: Search for available tools by name, description, or capability using BM25 ranking. Use this when you need to discover tools that can help with a task. Query with capability keywords rather than raw arguments, for example "list files" or "find issues".

query.description: Search query made of capability keywords or a short phrase.

category.description: Optional source filter for the results.

QVariant ToolSearchPlugin::searchRegex(Q.name: tool_search_regex
QVariant ToolSearchPlugin::searchRegex(Q.title: Search tools with regex
QVariant ToolSearchPlugin::searchRegex(Q.description: Search for available tools by matching a case-insensitive regular expression against tool names and descriptions. Use this when you know a specific naming pattern or capability. Examples: "github.*issue", "^get", "file|directory".

pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against tool names and descriptions.

category.description: Optional source filter for the results.
